context: Tatsuya-country tells Sho-young about a crab fishing expedition.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、カニ、釣ったことある?
lines.en: Grandpa, have you ever caught crabs?
lines.style: Soft, open-ended question. Curious but not demanding. Slight upward lilt at the end — genuinely wanting to know. Warm, the way a child asks someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おう、昔、海で冒険したで。
lines.en: Yeah, long time ago I went on adventures out at sea.
lines.style: Slow, patient opener. Slight smile in the voice. Reminiscent — settling into a memory. Warm and unhurried, like time doesn't matter when telling a story to this boy.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Is the sea bottom really deep?
lines.style: Genuine awe and wonder. Soft voice, slight hesitation — like he's trying to picture something vast. Leaning in, fully engaged. Not anxious, just amazed.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ようけ深い、潮、湧いてくる、面白い場所や。
lines.en: Real deep. Where the tide comes rushing up — that's where the interesting things are.
lines.style: Gentle, almost dreamy delivery. Speaks like he's looking out at the memory. Patient pause before 'interesting' — savoring the word. Warm affection for what he's remembering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, eager question with gentle hope underneath. Quick tempo, genuine interest. The eagerness of a child who knows something good is coming in the story.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: おう、ようけ食べた、家族で。
lines.en: Yeah, we ate plenty of it. The whole family did.
lines.style: Warm affirmation. Light touch on 'plenty' — a satisfied memory. Soft emphasis on family — he's including Sho in this warmth, drawing him into the memory.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: いつか、釣りに行きたい!
lines.en: I want to go fishing with you someday!
lines.style: Soft but determined. Not demanding — hopeful. Slight rise of excitement underneath the gentleness. The kind of quiet promise a child makes to someone he loves.
